note: §1's projection invariant, checked by §9: the decoded request inside `signed` and the record beside it must say the same thing. The payload is rewritten in the *bundle*, at the address the chain already names, so the signature still verifies over the request it covers and the record now contradicts it — the case a producer can create and no kernel would write.

kind.description: A one-field resource, so a verifier vector has something harmless to admit.

lines.signatures: admissions signed and verified with the keys on their payloads
